title: CaseGraphen MCP host: compile_reviewed_deployment_bundle payload
description: The literal `payload.compiler_request` an MCP client sends for the `compile_reviewed_deployment_bundle` tool. Distinct from mcp.proposal_compiler_input.v0: it names an accepted review's claim_cell_id instead of a base_revision_id, because a reviewed compilation is authorized by the review morphism, not by the caller's observed revision alone.
